BWHP141 is the Danish procedure code for treatment with filgotinib, a newer Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor [^src1]. Within the Danish healthcare system's tracking of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) therapies, it is categorized under the broader class of [[bmsl|Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler]] (biological and targeted synthetic drugs) [^src1]. 

Data from the DANIBD 2025 report, which serves as the national quality database for IBD, indicates that BWHP141 saw very limited clinical use during the tracking period of October 1, 2024, to September 30, 2025 [^src1]. Specifically, Appendix Table 6 shows that there were no registered treatments using this code among children, and only a few registrations among adult patients [^src1]. These technical appendix tables are central to evaluating treatment variation and patient access to advanced therapies across Danish hospitals [^src1].
